blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Religious leaders and civil society groups in Zamboanga del Sur kicked off the 2026 Mindanao Week of Peace Thursday, calling for Christians, Muslims, and Indigenous Peoples (IPs) to work actively together toward lasting harmony in the region. Led by the Interfaith Forum for Solidarity and Peace—a coalition of multi-faith leaders and civic organizations in Zamboanga del Sur—the opening event featured a solemn “Day of Prayer” anchored on this year’s theme, “Many journeys, one humanity: building peace.” Pagadian Bishop Ronald Anthony Timoner emphasized that despite differences in faith and perspectives, Mindanao’s diverse communities share a common […]...
